purpose: Conditional arithmetic for commercial investigation; no prediction or spending approval
baseline: Pinned accepted Steam GB/GBP final storefront price at its recorded retrieval time; not a current live quote or list-price discount
rounding: Hypothetical storefront prices rounded to integer pence, Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP; ratios calculated from rounded pence before six-decimal display rounding
baseline_paid_units: Unobserved; relative paid-unit index 100 is a normalization assumption, not a measured volume
baseline_engagement: Relative engagement index 100 is a normalization assumption, not measured activity, retention or a demand conversion
scenario_selection: Illustrative analyst-selected stress cases; not estimated, elicited, probable or recommended. Base is a named planning case, not an expected forecast.
gross_receipts_index: 100 * (rounded hypothetical price / observed anchor price) * assumed relative paid units; gross storefront transaction value only; does not model tax remittance, refunds, fees, costs or mix changes; not net revenue or profit
gross_receipts_neutral_paid_unit_factor: observed anchor price / rounded hypothetical price, only when both prices are positive; not cost break-even
engagement_use: Separate hypothetical index only; never enters the receipts equation or predicts purchases
decision_policy: Arithmetic above/at/below a receipts index of 100 identifies a conditional requirement, not Invest/Promote or budget approval. Require validated paid-unit response and contribution economics before action.
forecast_policy: No forecast, forecast error, confidence interval, elasticity or ROI until an explicitly admitted comparable target series, approved validation design and untouched holdout exist. Existing momentum thresholds do not certify forecasting sufficiency.
